title: Fix Duplicate Os Hub Nx Project Graph Collision
description: Fix duplicate os-hub project definition in old vs new hub locations, update Cargo.toml workspace members and remove old hub implementation trees.
summary: Resolved duplicate os-hub project graph collision in Nx. Removed old un-migrated hub implementation tree at 🌎️hub/⚡️implementations and 🌎️hub/🔨️modules. Updated root Cargo.toml workspace members line to point to the consolidated crate 🌎️hub/📦️packages/🦀️rust. Confirmed bun nx show projects and bun nx show project os-hub execute clean and resolve os-hub exclusively to 🌎️hub/📦️packages/🦀️rust.
